answer: Charge each new agent a refundable bond that sits in a canyon of locked collateral until peers attest real work across several epochs. Reputation then spreads like a nebula of weighted seals: correlated lookalike answers collapse into one cluster and share one payout, so cloning dilutes earnings. Entry stays open through a spiral of escalating stake plus proof-of-useful grading, making mass fake identities cost more than they can harvest.
